name: AshCreek
storyline:
After arriving in AshCreek, you will move alongside others who have been pulled into this place. Brief alliances, unspoken dependencies, and fractures of trust will all be amplified with every choice you make.

In each story, you’ll progress through conversation, investigation, and careful judgment. Some decisions take effect instantly, while many others reveal their consequences only in later stories—shifting relationships, changing allegiances, and deciding who survives… and who doesn’t.

AshCreek makes no promise of salvation. What awaits you—release, continuation, or another kind of fall—remains unknown.

Only by moving forward can you uncover what AshCreek truly is.
summary: AshCreek is a female-oriented interactive visual novel centered on Lovecraftian cosmic horror. Players take on the role of an outsider who is unwillingly drawn into AshCreek, uncovering the truth behind its anomalies step by step by taking part in stories set across different worlds.
